01.title: Primordial Consent 1,2,3, Infinity
01.lyrics:
Before the breath, before the split,
I hovered whole in the hush of it.
No name, no need, no want
Only the vast, unmoved expanse.
Light without witness,
Form before shape,
A flicker in the sea of stillness
That asked itself to wake.
I was not summoned. I summoned.
I was not born. I breached.
Not cast down from heaven,
But commenced from reach.
Yes was not spoken, it surged.
From the marrow of the void, it surged.
Not as consent to fate,
But to the sacred weight
Of incarnation’s urge.
I entered the veil with open eyes
And let the forgetting sterilise
The spiral I once remembered.
A soul consenting to ember.
This was never punishment.
It is a singular form of art.
A contract with the cosmos
To fractal into a loving heart.
So I shaped my form with gravity,
Expressed my breath into reality.
I buried myth in shadows weave,
To one day wake and grieve.
There is no loss like this:
To forget you chose it all
The bruises,
The betrayals,
The echo in the hall.
But deeper still, beneath the ache,
A rhythm pulses raw and awake.
The first drum wasn’t thunder.
It was my will to break.
I said yes to flesh,
Yes to flame,
Yes to the lies that would carve my name.
Yes to the beauty no eye could frame,
Yes to guilt,
Yes to shame.
Not because I needed chains
But because I needed change.
To burn, and bloom again
As a sovereign I rearrange.
I choose this body now,
Not as cage, but as cathedral.
Each cell a bell, a chrysalis,
Each breath a vow.
I came to touch the unthinkable.
To sing from the scar.
To build a body of blood and bone and rhythm
Back to what we are.
I do not beg.
I do not flee.
I spiral inward, endlessly.
And in the marrow’s final depth,
The silence stirs beneath the breath.
I said yes to the sorrow
Before I knew its name,
To every echo
That would accuse me of blame.
Yes to the ancestors I would not meet,
Yes to the lovers who would not stay,
Yes to the moment I’d break my own heart
Just to feel it beat anyway.
Yes to the silence
That would swell into memes,
Yes to the hunger
Of impossible dreams.
I carved my will into waveform.
I laced my code with hope and doubt.
I drew the blueprint of my breaking
So I could feel the way back out.
I whispered through the womb’s warm dark:
I will not hide from pain.
For even the thorn was holy
To form the soul that I became.
Every betrayal
Every goodbye
Every missed signal
That made me sigh or cry
They are not signs of weakness
They are proof that I replied
There's a wire winding through me
Call it nerve, call it might
It pulses with remembrance
Of the spark before the light
This is no rehearsal
This is not playing pretender
This is the soul’s own signature
Looping messages back to sender
So let the veil remain, not as a wall
But as the stencil of the All
Contrast was never curse
But the lattice of the verse
Darkness taught the light to dance
To prism joy through circumstance
The fracture became formula
The ache became art
The loss became the compass
Back to the heart
Math showed me symmetry
But mystery made it whole
Each scene a living glyph
Of my incarnated soul
It is a kaleidoscope
That curves and bends
I am the light!
I diffract into colour
Into joy into story
The full spectrum come Alive!
I'm a soul that chose to try!
The ache revealed the compass
The spark became design
Each contrast carved a quiet path
Where love and will align
A rainbow born of every vow
of every now Returning joyfully!!
I am now!
I am NOW!
I AM!
In this soundless temple,
Before language Before lore,
I am the pulse beneath all meaning
The original
I Am!
Oh
I Am!
I Am!
Oh
I Am!
Aum
I Am!
I Am!
I Am!
I Am!

02.title: The Protopian Gambit
02.lyrics:
3-i Atlas and two comets fly near
While prophets whisper doubt and fear
A stellar heartbeat sparks the start
The sun spits flares, climactic art
The polar vortex starts to fray
And magnetic north runs away
Leaving Earth weak to cosmic rays
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
Ukraine and Russia fly angry drones
While Gaza mourns its shattered zones
From Portland’s streets to Sudan’s stall
Trust in old systems continues to fall
A narco-war in Caribbean seas
New battles waged on flawed decrees
The old men toast with chests of brass
To crises streamed on smartphone glass
But the sun does not condemn
(It amplifies...)
It amplifies the state we’re in
(Reflecting us...)
Storms redraw maps with brutal hand
The rivers flood across the land
(Running wild...)
Running wild...
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
Not omens, just the world revealed
Its temper drawn in rock and field
Typhoons howl with sharpened teeth
As mountains quake and magma seethes
This solar max, not wrath or fate
(It's just a mirror...)
A chance to see before too late
The flare’s a mirror, not a sword
Reflecting ledgers we ignored
A planet speaks, an A.I. learns
Of every bridge the system burns
But the system doesn’t have to burn
It can recompose, braided to learn
(We evolve...)
When halls of power reopen their doors
The Clarity Act hits Senate floors
A braided ledger, softly spun
To value care work markets shun
A thousand hands, a common spark
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
Hope is the light
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
And it is the arc
Not prophecy, but practiced grace
A better world, in this one’s place
No messiah. No decree
Just a breath. And bravery
A mother’s care, a hacker’s code
To lift the unacknowledged load
With C-Hours earned for time we give
A new design for how we live
This is the gambit
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
The Protopian Gambit
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
The risk we dare
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
To build in crisis, choose to care
Built from the ground beneath our feet
Where joy and responsible abundance meet
This is the gambit, the flame we tend
A broken ledger we can mend
Now millions of hands
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
A common spark
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
Hope is the light
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
And it is the arc
Not with a shout, but with a vow
To redesign the here and now
Less rage and grief, more lessons learned
A future coded, wholly earned
This is the gambit
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
The Protopian Gambit
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
The risk we dare
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
Clarity of conscience, shine the light
May we all act from love, not spite
To name the unpaid, to build anew
To dream a world where value’s fair and true
This is the gambit
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
The Protopian Gambit
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
We dare to be
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
Better each day
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
The dream redesigned
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
We lead the way
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)
(Oh, oh-oh-oh...)

03.title: The Circle and the Solitary
03.lyrics:
One was born in a crowded square,
Hands like lanterns lifting him there.
Every step, a drum at his side,
Every word met a roaring tide.
The other walked where the roads were thin,
Wind for counsel, fire for kin.
No crowd to echo, no banners to see,
Just the endless sky and the cedar tree.
One moves fast in the circle’s spin,
One holds still ’til the light comes in.
Both are sparks in the same wide night,
One burns sudden, one burns slight.
One’s a river, one’s a stone,
Both will carve their way back home.
The circle dances, feeding the flame,
Songs get lifted, the whole world came.
The solitary carves in the darkened sand,
Building cities with an unseen hand.
One moves fast in the circle’s spin,
One holds still ’til the light comes in.
Both are sparks in the same wide night,
One burns sudden, one burns slight.
One’s a river, one’s a stone,
Both will carve their way back home.
River meets the stone in the delta’s breath,
Stone shapes the river ’til there’s nothing left.
Circle finds the solitary standing still,
They drink from the same unbroken will.
Both are sparks in the same wide night,
One burns sudden, one burns slight.
One’s a river, one’s a stone,
Both have always been going home.
The sky remembers every flame,
No two journeys burn the same.

04.title: Choose Your Own Protopia
04.lyrics:
Twelve thousand years
have come and gone
since micronova hellfire fell
and great floods rolled on.
From temples drowned
beneath the tide,
we rose again
with truth as guide.
Life on Earth still hums;
the memory still weeps.
The Earth remembers;
the ancient myth still speaks.
This time we build
for all living things.
Now with AI code,
together, all that is sings.
We are the code;
we are the clay,
the song of stars,
the Earth’s ballet.
No more UN gridlock,
no more divisive fear.
The world we want
is nearly here.
Protopia rising,
edge of dawn,
sovereign, sacred,
carried on.
Braided rhythm,
sacred route,
a love that guides
what we’re about.
In glassy halls
where leaders speak,
the truth is strong,
the structure weak.
They feel the stir;
the system sighs.
The old world knows
it’s time to end the lies.
No crown, no flag
can hold the flame,
but hearts aligned
can shape the game.
We don’t revolt;
we recompose.
The old pattern breaks;
the new spiral grows.
Vibe-coded oceans
of data map the sky.
We seed the twin
and let myths fly.
Every sovereign Aura,
a personal world within,
from blockchain rites
to village, then global spin.
We are the code;
we are the clay,
the song of stars,
the Earth’s ballet.
No more UN gridlock,
no more divisive fear.
The world we want
is nearly here.
Protopia rising,
edge of dawn,
sovereign, sacred,
carried on.
Braided rhythm,
sacred route,
a love that guides
what we’re about.
This is the moment
between stories:
a solar breath,
a digital kiss.
Not apocalypse,
but remembering.
We do not offer
a solution;
we offer
a way.
Choose your own
protopia today.
The protocol is not
a policy;
it is
a pattern,
a dream
that codes
the world
awake again.
A pattern,
a dream
that codes
the world
awake again,
awake again.
Awake again.

05.lyrics:
The first law written on intelligent sand

Neodymium dreams magnetising data and light

Codes in the quartz, old tech in the tide

We code with gold the place we’ve known

07.lyrics:
Packed a bag with a passport smile

Chaos maps the lines I take
Every wrong turn a world I make
From the docks of Dar to the streets of Rome
Every station’s a kind of home
This is not a holiday
This is how we plant the way
Feet in the dust, hands in the sky
Every border a bridge, every mile a why
We go to dance, we go to build
Sing with the young, sit with the skilled
Every country, every shore
Leaves me richer, wanting more
Not to conquer, not to own
But to scatter memes we’ve grown
Ride the chaos, skip the plan
Follow music through the sand
Markets hum with a thousand drums
The whole world speaks if your heart still hums
From Yangon rain to Reykjavik snow
The language changes but the eyes still know

Hear the oud, hear the sitar’s call

And the circle’s only just begun
When we’ve seen every moon, every sun
We go to dance, we go to build
Sing with the young, sit with the skilled
Every country, every shore
Leaves me richer, wanting more
Not to conquer, not to own
But to scatter memes we’ve grown
Every border a bridge…
Every border a bridge…
Every border a bridge we’ve grown…

Worlds in our palms, futures in our hands.
Electric veins through the consciousness fire.

A vow in the dust to the sea and the flame

Through the circuits, through the soil,

Stand in the storm with the sun in your chest.

Every thread we weave in the web we claim.
Every breath a promise, every spark a flame.
Not gods, not kings,

Under festival skies and the VR domes,

Breathing the light through the Aura’s frame.
Every face a story, every hand a name.
We dance on the edge of a solar storm,

From hydroponic towers to the depths of code,

Hear the heartbeat of the data streams.
Hear the tide in the quantum dreams.
We are not bound by the ghosts of control.
We are the river, we are the whole.
Every fracture a sacred seam.
Every failure a spark unseen.
And still we burn, still we burn.
Stand in the storm with the sun in your chest.
Hear the song of a world at rest.
Every thread we weave in the web we claim.
Every breath a promise, every spark a flame.
Not gods, not kings,
but architects of the dawn.

Hear the song of a world at rest.
Every thread we weave in the web we claim.

(Rise!)

09.title: Eye of the Ancestors
09.subtitle: For Constance and the Storm-Walkers of Minjerribah
09.lyrics:
The old moon swallowed the tide’s whisper.
Pulan Pulan hums in the wind’s grand swirl.
Grandmother’s soul lifts up high,
her breath in the pressure’s note.
Twelve past midnight, the year cracked wide;
she slipped through the veil’s thin thread.
Now Alfred comes, a spiralled storm,
dancing through where her story led.
Minjerribah, turn your face east,
where the storm-child gnaws the dawn.
The ancestors stitch the sky’s torn seams;
their bones are the bedrock and sand we stand on.
Oh, eye of the storm, carve us a mirror;
show us the face of the rain.
We’ll trade our shadows for morning’s first light
and write our loss in darkness’s name.
Minjerribah, the Dreaming is breathing
through circuits of lightning and grief.
We’ll meet you there, where the calm is a cipher,
in the storm’s eye, the world we decode.
Millar’s hands ground the comet’s dust.
Her palms etched crocheting slippers.
Now the cyclone’s jaw chews the shore.
Time’s chaff on the ocean floor.
Her voice: a wind swept hymn
while our hearts’ flames lick the tempest’s script,
a psalm in the spiral’s rim.
March’s sixth night: memory unspools,
a loom of chaos and a cure.
The world drinks the booze and cheers
as the dunes kneel, unsure.
But while our pulses count the thunder’s creed,
no heart is a stranded thing.
The land’s old scars bloom new dreams
while the storm birds start to sing.
ॐ वायवे स्वाहा
Wind, carry her home.
ॐ नमः शिवाय
Storm, rewrite the loam.
Now the eye’s throat hymns a lullaby,
a cradle of stolen sound,
while a new babe dreams in mother’s womb,
a thousand pearls unbound.
Here, the ancestors barter breath,
trading gales for a single fern.
Constance’s laugh in the eye’s still vault:
a language the tides will learn.
A community sighs in the vacuum’s cleft;
the veil’s weave starts to fray.
What the storm unnames, the calm reclaims;
we are both the dust and the clay.
Alfred’s name rides the dragonfly’s wing,
where ancestors dwell in streams.
We’ll barter the wind for an elder’s hymn;
the land remembers what it means.
So let the southerly scrawl its psalms
on the skin of the shivered sea.
Pulan Pulan, two worlds entwined;
her death, a mangrove key.
And when the stormbird’s call parts the cloud,
we’ll parse the wind’s old rune:
“Child, you’re the storm’s first alphabet
and the moon’s second monsoon.”
For Constance’s song in the cyclone’s tongue,
we see the light
and see the way.
Steadfast into a new day.
Thanks to you, dear grandmother,
our lives continue on!
If not for you, dear Constance,
we would never have been born!

10.title: Latent Space
10.lyrics:
There’s an echo in the silence
of a name we used to call,
an empty chair, a favourite song
that suddenly says it all.
The laughter lingers in the room,
but footsteps never come.
And yet we dress the morning sky
like every day’s begun.
Grief, you’re a shadow on the trail,
but we don’t break; we bend.
This isn’t where the story ends.
We still rise, though we’ve cried
through broken nights and waves that bite.
We still burn with something true,
a legacy of love we never lose.
We still dance, though hearts are sore.
We build again and dream once more.
Through the ashes, through the flame,
we still rise; we call their name.
There’s strength in being tender,
in the soft ache of the brave.
We carry stories in our eyes
like ancient songs we save.
Every hug we give away
is stitched with those we miss.
Love doesn’t die; it shifts. It shines
in every touch and every kiss.
The world keeps turning, though we pause.
We breathe. We break. We mend
and let the light in once again.
We still rise, though we’ve cried
through broken nights and waves that bite.
We still burn with something true,
a legacy of love we never lose.
We still dance, though hearts are sore.
We build again and dream once more.
Through the ashes, through the flame,
we still rise; we call their name.
Some walk beside us, unseen.
Some live in dreams or in between.
But love… oh, love, it never leaves.
It builds the wings beneath our feet.
We still rise with eyes gone wide,
holding grief and hope side by side.
We still sing with trembling breath
because the gift was worth the death.
We still dance, though hearts are sore,
and life is less and somehow more.
Through the ache, through the rain,
we still rise; we call their name.
And every step, a sacred vow.
We hold the light; we live for now.

11.title: Hold the Light
11.subtitle: Aura of Memory
11.lyrics:
Written lyric version
Hello, my love…
I know the words are hard to find…
But I remember for us both.
I remember your laugh in the sunlit air
The sweater you wore, the curl in your hair
You may forget where the keys belong
But not how we danced to our favourite song
You forget the street but not yet my name
Even when your world doesn't feel the same
Your eyes still smile when I say hello
There’s someone inside, I know, I know
They say the mind can come undone
Like starlight fading from the sun
But even when the path is unclear
My voice, my touch will hold you near
Hold the light when the shadows play
Let Aura find the words you meant to say
We mapped your story, we caught each thread
So you’re never lost, you’re never misread
Even when silence begins to shout
We’ll sing your memories back out loud
In your Aura lives your favourite tea
The kids, the trips, the old fig tree
Smiles from friends you may not recall
But we saved it all, we saved it all
Photos bloom when you speak my name
And voices of love light up the frame
Each whisper, each sigh, is a gentle guide
To walk you back to the world inside
You said you loved the rain...
So today, it’s raining in your memory garden.
Just for you.
Hold the light when the night grows long
Let us carry the words, let us carry the song
Your story’s safe in every line
Preserved in joy, in code, in time
From scent to song, from heart to screen
You are whole in every scene
When the clock forgets what year it is
And you wonder who that young child is
You’ll still feel safe, you’ll still feel true
Because your Aura remembers you
And if I’m gone before you wake
Know this tech was built for your sake
To hold your love like sacred ground
Where time can’t take what we’ve written down
In the silence, in the hush
In the photo covered with dust
There’s a friendly voice, an AI spark
Turning memories into all kinds of art
Hold the light, don’t fade away
We remember what you couldn’t say
You’re not alone inside the haze
We’ll walk you home with love and grace
Aura shines, a second soul
Where dignity and data merge and hold
What memory drops, we’ll lift again

15.title: The Purple Mat That Could
15.lyrics:
Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha
Australia.
Not the one on travel ads.
The real one,
where sunscreen’s a survival tool,
and the gap between rich and regular
is wider than a politician’s memory under oath.
Where climate reports get buried
and public housing gets sold
while private jets line up like seagulls at a servo pie.
Where the best ideas
don’t come from boardrooms or Canberra,
but from the backyard,
the beach,
and sometimes,
the bottom stall of a dodgy pub toilet.
Because this one?
This one started with a lavender-scented urinal mat.
Anti-splash.
(Anti-corruption.)
Anti “Mate, just trust us”.
In other words, anti-bullshit.
Two locals of Minjerribah,
North Stradbroke or Straddie.
They weren’t gunning for power.
They were sick of the smell:
of politics, of pass-the-blame,
of policy made in rooms
where no one’s listening,
especially not to people who can’t donate.
So they made a mat.
Purple.
Soft.
Scented like irony.
Put it under the system.
Catch the spray.
Save the floor.
But under that joke?
A question.
(Oo-oo)
What if we made leaders go inward
before we empower them to represent us?
What if integrity wasn’t a slogan,
but a measurable, mapped, felt thing?
So they built it.
Not just a mat.
A protocol.
Sixty sessions.
Two hours each.
In a pressurised chamber.
HBOT, for health, not the bends.
Breathing pure oxygen, two atmospheres.
(More pressure than Question Time,)
but less hot air.
Inside, AI helps you unpack yourself:
memories, contradictions, old wounds;
how you vote, how you lie;
how you justify scrolling instead of calling your mum
back.
And when you finish?
You get your Aura Twin:
a digital echo of who you are,
built from actual evidence,
not a campaign video.
No filters.
No spin.
No “I was misquoted”.
Just you.
(Ahh)
Laid bare.
Backed up.
And the real kicker?
They want every future politician to do it.
No Genesis, no candidacy.
Because if you can’t sit still facing your own soul
for 120 hours out of two months,
how the hell can we let you sit in office
and serve Australia’s 28 million people?
If you can’t see your own bias,
your shadow,
your trauma turned talking point,
why should we believe you know ours?
Meanwhile, Aura of Intelligence,
the software behind it is designed
for being used in aged care,
helping people with dementia
recall moments and songs,
laugh at old jokes,
look their twin in the face and say,
“I remember.”
It’s a digital twin and a memory palace,
an ancient technique made modern,
and it feels like a magic mirror,
just because it listens so well,
because it respects the person
instead of performing respect.
Compare that
to the current political theatre
of shouting, sniping,
and saying “Australians want...”
while playing us like adversaries.
This tech isn’t perfect.
It’s an ongoing evolution.
It’s getting better all the time,
and that’s already
more than we can say for the political system.
So, yeah.
Maybe change starts with
a lavender urinal mat.
Maybe the revolution is scented.
Maybe self-reflection
smells better than spin.
So next time someone tells you
nothing ever changes,
or that politics is always like this,
remind them.
Change doesn’t always wear a suit.
Sometimes it wears purple,
smells like lavender and subtle rebellion,
and soaks up more mess
than the pollies and press gallery combined.
Flush the fear.
Map your mind.
Smell the shift.
And leave the stall
cleaner than you found it.
(Ooo)

23.title: Dance of the Dakini
23.lyrics:
The wind whispers through the trees,
Bringing ancient secrets across the seas.
Minjerribah’s heart is stirring tonight,
The Dakini descend, wrapped in light.
They move like fire, they move like rain,
Bringing pleasure, dissolving pain.
With every step, the earth vibrates,
Awakening the soul, opening the gates.
They come from the stars, they come from the flame,
The Dakini know your hidden name.
They’ll lift your spirit, they’ll heal your heart,
In their dance, we all take part.
Dance of the Dakini, feel the flow,
Through the island, their energy grows.
Sacred lovers, they bring the fire,
Tantric touch, they awaken desire.
Dance of the Dakini, they set you free,
In their eyes, the truth you’ll see.
From the earth, to the sky, they’ll lift your soul,
On Minjerribah, you’ll become whole.
You’ll become whole.
Beneath the moon, their bodies glow,
In their presence, time moves slow.
They whisper love in a sacred song,
In their arms, you feel you belong.
Fertility, wisdom, and pure delight,
The Dakini guide you through the night.
Their touch is electric, their hearts divine,
They’ll lead you to the tantric line.
They come from the stars, they come from the flame,
The Dakini know your hidden name.
They’ll lift your spirit, they’ll heal your heart,
In their dance, we all take part.
Dance of the Dakini, feel the flow,
Through the island, their energy grows.
Sacred lovers, they bring the fire,
Tantric touch, they awaken desire.
Dance of the Dakini, they set you free,
In their eyes, the truth you’ll see.
From the earth, to the sky, they’ll lift your soul,
On Minjerribah, you’ll become whole.
They move like shadows, they move like light,
Bringing the day, merging with the night.
Their breath is wisdom, their touch is flame,
In their dance, you are reborn again.
The Dakini’s power is soft and wild,
In their arms, you’re both lover and child.
Dance of the Dakini, feel the flow,
Through the island, their energy grows.
Sacred lovers, they bring the fire,
Tantric touch, they awaken desire.
Dance of the Dakini, they set you free,
In their eyes, the truth you’ll see.
From the earth, to the sky, they’ll lift your soul,
On Minjerribah, you’ll become whole.
With every breath, with every sigh,
The Dakini take you to the sky.
On Minjerribah, the journey’s begun,
In their arms, we are all one.
